sentences.text: Crr/3587/2024 on 4 October, 2024
Author: Joymalya Bagchi
Bench: Joymalya Bagchi 04.10.2024
IN THE HIGH COURT AT CALCUTTA
Sl. No.14 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction

akd [Adjourned]
 C. R. R. 3587 of 2024
In Re: Sourav Majumder @ Saurabh Majumder  ... ... Petit
Mr. Kaushik Choudhury
for the petitioner

1.
Petitioner submits opposite party no.2-wife had deserted the matrimonial home in 2020 after he had suffered a road traffic accident.
After three years, she has instituted the impugned criminal proceeding.
2. I have considered the allegations in the FIR in light of the aforesaid submissions.

In the FIR,
opposite party no.2-wife alleged she had left the matrimonial home in July, 2019.
No explanation is forthcoming why no criminal case was registered soon thereafter.
Allegation of refusal to return stridhan articles in 2022 has not been prima facie believed by the police and no charge sheet under Section 406 IPC has been filed.
3. Under such circumstances, we are of the opinion petitioner has made out an arguable case in his favour.

4. Let a copy of the petition be served upon opposite party no.1-State through the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and opposite party no.2 through Registered Speed Post with Acknowledgment Due and file affidavit-of-service on the next date of hearing.
5. Let the matter appear as 'Contested Application' four weeks after ensuing Puja Vacation.
6.

There shall be stay of the impugned proceeding being G.R. Case No.1136 of 2024 arising out of Kotwali Police Station Case No.769 of 2022 dated 29.07.2022 under Sections 498A/406/354/34 of the Indian Penal Code pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 2nd Court, Krishnanagar,
CRR/3587/2024 on 4 October, 2024
